name: Chicken Taco Salad Boats with Black Beans, Tomato, Guacamole & Lime

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ pint grape tomatoes
½ small bunch green onions (scallions)
½ lime
1 heart romaine hearts

instructions.primary_message: Halve tomatoes and place on a plate.
Trim green onions; cut crosswise into ¼-inch pieces and add to the plate with the tomatoes, keeping them separate.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, cut lime into wedges and add to the plate; set aside.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken and cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until almost cooked through, about 3 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tsp extra virgin olive oil
227 g ground chicken

instructions.primary_message: While the chicken is cooking, drain and rinse beans in a colander.

Add beans, water, and taco seasoning to the skillet with the chicken; continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until sauce has thickened and the meat is no longer pink, 2-3 minutes more. Remove taco filling from the heat.
Meanwhile, trim off and discard root end of the romaine heart; separate the leaves to use as taco shells and divide between plates.
Divide taco filling between the romaine leaves; top with tomatoes and green onions. Serve with guacamole and lime wedges on the side. Enjoy!
